randomPoints.method: Fresh Python horizon.py and build_forecast.build_tables. DE440 quick ephemeris evaluated at reference terrain height is shared to isolate terrain; not independent ephemeris ground truth. 365 days, 10-minute cadence.

previousIndependentAstronomyCheck.method: Verified CSPICE DE440/ME421 CN+S at each model ground + 2m; no gravitational deflection. Python hourly reference is rounded to 0.01 deg. Same underlying JPL model, not measured ground truth.
